name: Git Command Explorer
summary: Build ready-to-run Git commands by filling placeholders — clone, commit, branch, and more.
description: Pick a Git action, fill in branch names, paths, messages, or remotes, and copy the finished command. Search and filter by category. Destructive commands are labeled. Runs entirely locally.

faqs.question: Does this run Git on my machine?
faqs.answer: No. It only builds the command string for you to paste into a terminal.

faqs.question: How is this different from the cheat sheet?
faqs.answer: The explorer focuses on parameterized commands you can customize; the cheat sheet is a broader searchable reference.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Everything runs in your browser.
